pdf-lib 1.17.1 (Andrew Dillon) — MIT License, see LICENSE.md.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdf-lib (dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js), renamed .js; only the sourceMappingURL comment removed.
Contains no eval / new Function (checked), so it runs under the strict Content-Security-Policy.
Used by the 0.39.0 signature tool (ui/js/pdf-sign.js) to place a drawn signature on a PDF entirely in the browser:
the PDF and the signature are never sent to the server.
